files.html:
0.2.7 Change Log

Changed

  • Improved server-side NPC AI performance and reduced unnecessary repeated calculations.
  • Improved the Mods configuration screen layout, readability, and multilingual text support.
  • Improved vehicle pathfinding recovery and target search efficiency.

Added

  • Added server-wide controls for optional NPC AI features.
  • Added separate toggles for vehicle AI and mercenary AI.
  • Added server AI settings synchronization and clearer status logging.

Fixed

  • Fixed NPCs continuing to target or fire at players after switching to Creative or Spectator mode.
  • Fixed stale target data and combat memory not being cleared correctly.
  • Fixed repeated vehicle pathfinding attempts when a vehicle is blocked.
  • Fixed several NPC pose, idle movement, and runtime cache issues.
